glossary.definition: (1) "Tamper with" means to remove permanently, bypass, defeat, or render inoperative, in whole or part, any emission control system that is installed on or in a motor vehicle.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3704.16 to 3704.162 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3704.16 - Prohibiting tampering with motor vehicle emission control systems.

glossary.definition: (2) "Motor vehicle" has the same meaning as in section 4501.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3704.16 to 3704.162 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3704.16 - Prohibiting tampering with motor vehicle emission control systems.

glossary.definition: (3) "Emission control system" means any system designated by the United States environmental protection agency as an emission control system under Title II of the "Clean Air Act Amendments." "Emission control system" includes any device or element of design of the system.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3704.16 to 3704.162 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3704.16 - Prohibiting tampering with motor vehicle emission control systems.

glossary.definition: (4) "Clean Air Act Amendments" has the same meaning as in section 3704.14 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3704.16 to 3704.162 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3704.16 - Prohibiting tampering with motor vehicle emission control systems.
